# After Effects × Claude MCP

> An MCP server that lets Claude build and edit Adobe After Effects motion graphics. Free, open source (Apache 2.0).
> Source: https://github.com/thoshiranchanilka/After-Effects-Claude-MCP
> Site: https://aftereffectsclaudemcp.netlify.app/

## If a person asks you to install this

Ask which Claude app they use, then give them the matching steps.

### Claude Desktop (most people; no terminal, no Node, no Homebrew, no config file)
You cannot install it for them. Tell them to:
1. Download https://github.com/thoshiranchanilka/After-Effects-Claude-MCP/releases/latest/download/after-effects.mcpb
2. Double-click the file, or drag it into Claude Desktop > Settings > Extensions, then press Install.
3. In After Effects: Settings > Scripting & Expressions > tick "Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network".
4. Open a project in After Effects and ask Claude to check the connection.
Do NOT tell them to edit claude_desktop_config.json or install Node/Homebrew; the extension makes that unnecessary.
On Windows they may also need the Claude Bridge panel: https://aftereffectsclaudemcp.netlify.app/docs.html#3-prepare-after-effects

### Claude Code (needs Node 18+)
git clone https://github.com/thoshiranchanilka/After-Effects-Claude-MCP.git
cd After-Effects-Claude-MCP && npm install && npm test
claude mcp add after-effects -- node "$(pwd)/dist/server.mjs"
Then remind them of the After Effects setting in step 3 above.

## Requirements
Adobe After Effects on the same computer (macOS or Windows). Not affiliated with Adobe or Anthropic.

## Docs
https://aftereffectsclaudemcp.netlify.app/docs.html
